sentences.en: The skyscraper's elevators ascend at an astonishing rate of speed.
sentences.zh: 这座摩天大楼的电梯以惊人的速度上升。

sentences.en: This mountain path ascends to the beautiful lake.
sentences.zh: 这条山路蜿蜒上升至美丽的湖泊。

sentences.en: Sami ascended the minbar to deliver the khutbah.
sentences.zh: 萨米登上讲坛发表了布道词。
